shape_keys.name: Basis
shape_keys.physics: Fock |0⟩ ground state — W_0=(2/π)exp(-2r²) Gaussian always positive

shape_keys.name: SK_Fock1
shape_keys.physics: Fock |1⟩ first excited — W_1=(1/π)(4r²-1)exp(-2r²) negative at origin r<1/2

shape_keys.name: SK_Fock5
shape_keys.physics: Fock |5⟩ fifth excited — W_5=(1/π)L_5(4r²)exp(-2r²) five concentric rings alternating sign

shape_keys.name: SK_Cat
shape_keys.physics: Schrodinger cat (|+2⟩+|-2⟩)/N alpha=2 — two Gaussian peaks + cos(4p*alpha) interference fringes

shape_keys.name: SK_Squeezed
shape_keys.physics: Squeezed vacuum r=1.2 — elliptical Gaussian sigma_q=e^{-1.2}/sqrt(2) sigma_p=e^{1.2}/sqrt(2)

physics.definition: W(q,p) = (1/pi) int psi*(q+y) psi(q-y) exp(2ipy) dy
physics.marginals: int W dp = |psi(q)|^2 ; int W dq = |phi(p)|^2
physics.negativity: W<0 iff state is non-Gaussian (Hudson 1974 Rep Math Phys 6:249)
